Check out https://www.youtube.com/@RingConnOfficial using our link! Gen 2 is 15% off for Halloween, October 30-31: https://bit.ly/4inH1fU
See our RingConn Gen2 Unboxing: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HAQNn6y8Lz0

Back in my day, getting more memory for your GPU simply just meant buying a new one. Not anymore! Luke travelled all the way to Michigan to meet up with the one and only Greg from GPU Lab to upgrade his RTX 4090 to have a whopping 48GB of VRAM

Check out Greg!: https://www.youtube.com/@UC6UqUv4r97LPDQAAEVsNI6w 
https://gpulab.net/
